reviewNotes: Twenty-five Stardew Valley Fair prompts, fortune-teller lines, results, and dialogue choices were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover glossary terms, exact command and response IDs, placeholders, dialogue tokens, gender-neutral dynamic references, UI brevity, punctuation, and voice; both found no remaining objective issue.

Event.cs.1652.source: Step right up! Pick a color and place your bet for a chance to double your wager!
Event.cs.1652.translation: Poftiți, poftiți! Alege o culoare și pariază pentru șansa de a-ți dubla miza!

Event.cs.1659.source: Selling Star Tokens for just 50g a piece!
Event.cs.1659.translation: Vând Jetoane stelare cu doar 50g bucata!

Event.cs.1666.source: Play the slingshot game and win star tokens!
Event.cs.1666.translation: Joacă jocul cu praștia și câștigă Jetoane stelare!

Event.cs.1672.source: Trade in your star tokens for prizes?

Event.cs.1681.source: Try your hand at some fishing? You could win big.
Event.cs.1681.translation: Încerci să pescuiești? Ai putea câștiga mult.

Event.cs.1684.source: Please stand at the red arrow.
Event.cs.1684.translation: Te rog să stai la săgeata roșie.

Event.cs.1691.source: Ah, yes... my crystal ball is swirling with visions of your future, young one.
Event.cs.1691.translation: Ah, da... globul meu de cristal freamătă de viziuni despre viitorul tău, suflet tânăr.

Event.cs.1694.source: I've already read your fortune... go away.

Event.cs.1695.source: You don't have enough money to pay my fee... What a shame.
Event.cs.1695.translation: Nu ai destui bani pentru onorariul meu... Ce păcat.
